```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)
```
```{r}
# function to define the B3 lab theme
theme_B3 <- function () { 
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),  # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),  # remove minor gridlines
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # center & bold
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # center & bold 
    )
}
```
```{r figure out working directory}
getwd()
```

#1.Get general data together:
```{r}
data_dry <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/Chapter2_cropmilk/R_markdowns/parent_cropmilkDM.csv")
```

#2.import key with relevant treatment groups
  #key MUST have the following columns: sample, treatment, brood
```{r}
key <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/keys/parent_key.csv")
```

#3. merge key and raw data and create nest type category, also change names a little
```{r}
data_dry <- left_join(data_dry, key, by = "sample")
data_dry$sex[data_dry$treatment == "single male"] <- "male"
data_dry$sex[data_dry$treatment == "single female"] <- "female"
data_dry$sex[data_dry$treatment == "paired male"] <- "male"
data_dry$sex[data_dry$treatment == "paired female"] <- "female"
data_dry$type[data_dry$treatment == "single male"] <- "single parent"
data_dry$type[data_dry$treatment == "single female"] <- "single parent"
data_dry$type[data_dry$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired parent"
data_dry$type[data_dry$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired parent"
data_dry$treatment[data_dry$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired mother"
data_dry$treatment[data_dry$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired father"
data_dry$treatment[data_dry$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
data_dry$treatment[data_dry$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
```
# removing abandoned nest
```{r}
data_dry_rm <- data_dry[-c(4), ]
```
# counting actual samples measured
```{r}
data_dry_rm %>% count(treatment)
```
#4. calculate % dry matter and obtain CV replicate mean
```{r}
data_dry_rm$percent <- data_dry_rm$avg_dry_m*100
```

```{r determine mean}
CV_mean <- data_dry_rm %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(cv_replicate, na.rm = TRUE))
CV_mean
```

#5. visualize data and analyze
```{r,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dryw <- ggplot(aes(y = percent, x = treatment, fill = treatment), data = data_dry_rm) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_parent) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired mother","paired father", "single mother", "single father")) + labs(title = "percent crop milk DM retained by parents", x="", y="% dry matter") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="", size=16)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="", size = 16)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single father", "paired mother")), map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 9) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("paired father", "paired mother")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(40), textsize = 9) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single father", "single mother")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(40), textsize = 9) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single mother", "paired father")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(50), textsize = 9) + ylim(0,65)
dryw
```

```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ treatment, data = data_dry_rm, center=mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ brood, data = data_dry_rm, center=mean)
```
# so parametric test ok
```{r}
lmer_dry <- lmer(percent ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = data_dry_rm, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_dry, type = "II", test = "F")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_dry, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
# so significant difference by treatment groups
```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(lmer_dry, list(pairwise ~ treatment), adjust="tukey") 
```
# so significant difference between paired mothers and paired fathers, single mothers and paired fathers, single fathers and paired mothers, and single mothers and single fathers.  

## effect size look
#subsets of treatment groups
```{r}
pmom <- data_dry_rm[data_dry_rm$treatment == "paired mother",]
pfath <- data_dry_rm[data_dry_rm$treatment == "paired father",]
smom <- data_dry_rm[data_dry_rm$treatment == "single mother",]
sfath <- data_dry_rm[data_dry_rm$treatment == "single father",]
```

# paired fathers v paired mothers
```{r}
pfath_v_pmom <- full_join(pfath,pmom)
cohens_d(percent ~ treatment, data = pfath_v_pmom)
```

# paired fathers v single mothers
```{r}
pfath_v_smom <- full_join(pfath,smom)
cohens_d(percent ~ treatment, data = pfath_v_smom)
```

#single mothers v single fathers
```{r}
sfath_v_smom <- full_join(sfath,smom)
cohens_d(percent ~ treatment, data = sfath_v_smom)
```

#single fathers versus paired mothers
```{r}
sfath_v_pmom <- full_join(sfath,pmom)
cohens_d(percent ~ treatment, data = sfath_v_pmom)
```

# by nest type and sex
```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ type, data = data_dry_rm, center=mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ sex, data = data_dry_rm, center=mean)
```
# so parametric test ok
```{r}
fit_dry <- aov(percent ~ type*sex, data = data_dry_rm)
Anova(fit_dry, type = "II")
```
# so significant difference by sex in general. 
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_dry, type = "II"))
```
